description: Phase 3 & 4: Congregation Output Window enhancements and Operator Window completion - crossfade transitions (Cut/Fade/Dissolve), theme system with backgrounds/fonts/shadows/logo, chord display toggle, operator service order panel, live/next preview, slide thumbnails, backtrack status, transport controls, and keyboard shortcuts.
steps: Enhance WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OutputWindow.xaml.cs: Add chord display toggle (property ShowChords, when false strips chords from displayed text using ChordProParserService). Add ThemeManager integration that reads SlideTheme and applies all properties (background image/color, font family/size/bold/italic, text shadow, gradient overlay, line spacing, margins, logo).
Add a ThemeManager service in WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Services/ThemeManager.cs that loads/saves SlideTheme objects from a Themes/ folder, provides default themes, and notifies on theme change.

Enhance WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Views/OperatorWindow.xaml and .xaml.cs: Complete the operator window with full functionality - service order list with drag/drop reorder, per-item icons and type indicators, live/next slide preview panels that render actual slide content (not just text), slide thumbnail strip that highlights current slide, backtrack status panel showing song/section/position/tempo/pitch in real-time, transport controls (next/prev slide/item, go live, black, logo). Add all keyboard shortcuts from PresenterSettings (configurable).
Add slide thumbnail rendering as small preview boxes in the OperatorWindow showing first line of each slide text, with section name labels above groups.
Create WorshipPlayer.Presenter/Controls/SlidePreviewControl.xaml + .xaml.cs - a reusable WPF UserControl that renders a miniature slide preview (background + text + theme applied at small scale).
Wire the chord display toggle to the output: add a toolbar button in OperatorWindow that toggles ShowChords on/off for the congregation output (stage always shows chords).
acceptance_criteria: OutputWindow applies full SlideTheme properties (background, fonts, shadow, logo, gradient)
OutputWindow supports chord display toggle (strips or shows chords)
OperatorWindow shows complete service order with icons
findings: ThemeManager source file is linked into the test project via Compile Include since the Presenter project (net8.0-windows) cannot be referenced from the test project (net8.0). All 93 tests pass (73 pre-existing + 20 new ThemeManager tests). The Song model uses OriginalKey (not Key) and has no direct Capo property. Backtrack info (key/capo/tempo/pitch) is shown in operator window and updated via PresenterEngine events.
